findings.issue: Glossary freezes 'Mortal Clothing' as زيّ الفانين (the mortals' garb) specifically warning against 'the perishable garment' reading. This row uses الزيّ الفاني (adjectival 'the mortal/perishable garment'), which is exactly the rejected interpretation.

findings.source_en: Refunded Glimpses are found in the Shell Keeper's alcove in Blackmarrow.
